plan.p0: Mechanism: On the original grid, find every axis-aligned 3×3 window containing only 0s and recolor the union of those windows to 1. Distinguishing assumption: overlapping qualifying windows are all included, so their footprints may merge.
plan.p1: Mechanism: Detect planted, maximal 3×3 zero squares and recolor each square to 1. Distinguishing assumption: a zero square is ignored if it is part of a larger all-zero rectangle; this can differ from sliding-window detection on larger blank areas.
plan.p2: Mechanism: Infer the dominant background color in each grid, then recolor every all-background 3×3 window to 1. Distinguishing assumption: 0 is not intrinsically special; a future grid dominated by another color could produce marked regions there instead.
plan.p3: Mechanism: Find all exact 3×3 zero windows, but choose the replacement color as the smallest color absent from the input. Distinguishing assumption: the observed marker is 1 because 1 is absent in both examples; another input could therefore use a different marker.
